description: Hand-curated ground truth for the query pipeline. Every expected value is copied from the committed PDFs in eval/corpus/ and is verified against the rendered text by tests/test_eval_corpus.py. If eval/generate_corpus.py changes a number, this file must change with it.
matching: expected_answer_contains is matched case-insensitively after collapsing whitespace and stripping thousands separators, so '1,240.00' also matches '1240.00'.

cases.question: What is the total due on Nordwind invoice NW-2401?
cases.notes: Baseline lookup. Two Nordwind invoices exist, so the invoice number must be honoured.

cases.question: What is the total due on Nordwind invoice NW-2403?
cases.notes: Same vendor as NW-2401. Retrieving the wrong Nordwind invoice yields 1,240.00.

cases.question: Which Nordwind invoice covers freight forwarding to Antwerp? Give the invoice number.
cases.notes: Disambiguation by line-item content rather than by invoice number in the question.

cases.question: How much did Nordwind charge for warehouse storage on invoice NW-2401?
cases.notes: Single line item, not the total. Tests that the model reads the row, not the summary.

cases.question: What currency is the Kranich Software invoice issued in?
cases.notes: Only non-EUR document in the corpus.

cases.question: What VAT rate is applied on the Kranich Software invoice?
cases.notes: 20% here versus 19% on every German document, so a cross-document mix-up is visible. Needle includes the percent sign: a bare '20' also matches inside any 2024 date.

cases.question: What is the total due on the Vogel Druck invoice?
cases.notes: Raster scan with no text layer: skewed, speckled, low contrast. Exercises the vision path and is expected to be the hardest case in the set.

cases.question: What is the invoice number on the Vogel Druck invoice?
cases.notes: Alphanumeric read off the same degraded scan; character-level rather than numeric.

cases.question: How much notice must a party give to terminate the consulting services agreement?
cases.notes: Clause 4 also contains a 14-day cure period, so 14 is the plausible wrong answer. Needle includes the unit: a bare '60' also matches inside '76,000' once separators are stripped.

cases.question: What is the day rate under the consulting services agreement?
What is the maximum total in fees payable during the initial term of the consulting agreement?
cases.notes: Same clause as the day rate; the model must pick the cap, not the rate.

cases.question: Which courts have exclusive jurisdiction under the mutual non-disclosure agreement?
cases.notes: The NDA parties are in Zurich and Berlin, so naming either city is the wrong answer.

cases.question: What was the total on the Papierhaus Berlin receipt?
cases.notes: Shortest document in the corpus; tests retrieval of a small chunk.

cases.question: How many employees were there at the end of Q3?
cases.notes: Prose, not a labelled field. The same sentence contains 41 (end of Q2) and 22 (engineering).

cases.question: What is the total on the Siemens invoice?
cases.notes: No Siemens document exists. The pipeline should abstain and cite nothing.

cases.question: What is the company's employee stock option policy?
cases.notes: Topic absent from the corpus entirely; retrieval will still return its five nearest chunks.

cases.question: How much did Nordwind charge for air freight in December 2023?
cases.notes: Adversarial: the vendor is real and Nordwind invoices will retrieve strongly, but there is no air freight line and no December 2023 invoice. Tests abstention under confident retrieval.
